note: Needs for domains 1 to 9 are one-line paraphrases of Abundance Structures v0.3. Needs for domains 10 to 12 are Claude's drafts. Structure names and statuses are from Abundance Structures v0.3. A null form or capture risk is still to be written: render it as a placeholder.

domains.name: Money
domains.need: A monetary system that preserves the value of savings and that no single actor can manipulate.

structures.name: Value investment channels from sound money to productive activity
Sound money standards and monetary reform

domains.name: Information and knowledge
domains.need: Information that gives honest feedback, and that no central actor controls access to.

structures.name: Open source software and protocol infrastructure

domains.name: Governance
domains.need: Decisions made at the right scale, tied to their consequences, hard to capture and able to change their own rules.

structures.name: Citizens' assemblies and deliberative democracy mechanisms
Decentralized autonomous organizations and smart contract governance

domains.name: Health
domains.need: Incentives that reward producing health more than managing disease.
domains.needFull: An incentive architecture in which producing health, not managing disease events, is the main activity of health systems, and in which people have real capacity to make informed decisions about their own health.

analysis.howItWorksToday: A health system organized around treating disease more than building health. [SUMMARY OF THE HIDDEN TIDE IN THIS DOMAIN]
analysis.whatAbundanceWouldLookLike: [WHAT CHANGES FOR AN ORDINARY PERSON WHEN THE STRUCTURE CHANGES]
analysis.whatStandsInTheWay: [THE INCENTIVES THAT KEEP THE PRESENT ARRANGEMENT IN PLACE]
analysis.whatWeDontKnow: [WHERE THE EVIDENCE RUNS OUT, AND THE STRONGEST OBJECTION]

structures.name: Direct primary care and value-based care
structures.captureRisk: Growth pressure. A practice that starts billing insurance gives up the incentive that defines it.

structures.name: Open prevention knowledge
structures.captureRisk: Wellness-industry capture. Low-quality information travels through the same channels as sound guidance.

domains.name: Education
domains.need: Learning that builds real competence, open to everyone, and recognized without institutional gatekeeping.
domains.note: Merges the two education domains in Abundance Structures v0.3.

structures.name: Distributed practice environments and mentorship networks

domains.name: Production and labor
domains.need: As the cost of making things falls, the gains reach people broadly instead of concentrating with whoever coordinates.

structures.name: Worker ownership and cooperative production models
Floor security mechanisms and the universal free floor food model
Open coordination infrastructure for physical production

domains.name: Community
domains.need: Institutions that rebuild connection, mutual aid and civic participation.

structures.name: Community land trusts and shared equity models
Digital community platforms with genuine local governance
Mutual aid and community resilience networks

domains.name: Ecology
domains.need: Irreplaceable natural systems protected through local, adaptive governance.

domains.name: Energy
domains.need: Energy cheap, clean and distributed enough to underpin everything else.

domains.name: Security and defence
domains.need: Safety from violence without concentrating the power to commit it.

domains.name: Justice and conflict resolution
domains.need: Disputes settled cheaply, locally and fairly, with basic rights protected.

domains.name: Global coordination and borders
domains.need: Shared problems managed across many nested boundaries, without a single center.
